title: When sending a mail to a list of recipients, is there a way to exclude one of the group members?
creator: artfunk
content: I have a friend who send me things that I often like to share with others who are on a distribution list. He is also a member of that group. When I forward what he sent me to the group, I would like to exclude him from receiving that mail. How can I do this without removing him from the group list each time?

title: I lost my Inbox of emails.
creator: hemlock6334
content: I changed Google accounts from mine to my husband's so that I could find a certain email. Finished and signed back into my Google account. Shut everything and went to my Thunderbird. My entire inbox of emails for my gmail account were not there. Why would I lost those if I was not dealing with Thunderbird, but Google online?? Google online only shows those emails that I haven't downloaded to Thunderbird. Google online did not show my current gmail Thunderbird Inbox, yet it's gone from Thunderbird. I'm sick about it... prescious emails lost. Is there any way to retrieve my Inbox?

title: Not receiving messages on my desktop
creator: eric52
content:
I use Thunderbird on my desktop and since early June, I have not been able to receive any new messages but I can still send. Everything works fine on webmail (Yahoo) and phone (Samsung Galaxy), it's just my desktop which is affected . I asked Duck AI about this and this is what I got...

https://duckduckgo.com/?t=ffab&q=thunderbird+connection+to+server+pop.mail%2Cyaho.com++timed+out&atb=v417-1&ia=web

I tried the solutions offered without success.

title: email sync met google-mail levert dubbele mails op.
creator: hjpakket
content:
Thunderbird geinstalleerd. Na enige tijd heeft Thunderbird alle emails uit google mail geimporteerd maar wel verdubbeld en met als berichtdatum de huidige importdatum. Hierdoor is het niet meer te zien of het om oude of recente mails gaat.

Google mail heb ik opgebouwd met submappen voor groepen zoals Familie, NUTS, hardsoftware, Prive, enz. Al deze submappen zijn keurig overgenomen. Maar TB heeft ook een map aangemaakt met "alle emails" en daarin staan betreffende emails uit de submappen nog een keer.

Het betreft ca 5.500 emails tot o.a. tientallen jaren terug. In de map "alle emails" staan deze 5.500 nogmaals maar nu niet met de oorspronkelijke maildatum maar met de huidige importdatum. Hierdoor is het niet duidelijk of het "oude" of "recente" emails zijn en moet ik alle teksten lezen om dit in te schatten.

Het is mij niet duidelijk of ik de map "alle emails" zonder probleem kan verwijderen omdat de mails ook nog steeds in de submappen staan met daarbij de juiste emaildatum.

title: Is One Person Company Registration the Right Choice for Solo Entrepreneurs?
creator: gauravsharma9718
content:
I’m planning to start a business on my own and have been reading about [[One Person Company Registration|https://corpbiz.io/one-person-company]] (OPC). It seems like a popular option for solo entrepreneurs because it offers a separate legal identity and limited liability while allowing a single owner to manage the company.

I’d like to hear from business owners and professionals who have experience with OPC registration:

  • Why did you choose an OPC over a Sole Proprietorship?
